data.title: D · 安全屋餐桌旁的围裙回眸
data.description: 掩藏在普通民居里的安全屋内，餐桌上摆着冒着热气的家常晚餐。D卸下战术风衣，只穿着宽松的居家白色围裙与内衬。她双手轻扶着实木餐椅靠背，金棕色的长发垂落在白皙光洁的香肩上。这位冷酷无情的顶级暗杀者，在只有两人的安全屋中，眉眼间化作专属于“人妻”身份的极致温柔与心跳张力。
data.location: safehouse dining room illuminated by warm candlelight
data.action: standing beside dining table leaning on wooden chair, white domestic apron over bare shoulders, long brown hair cascading, soft tender blush, gentle domestic smile
data.lighting: warm hanging dining pendant lamp creating a golden circle of home warmth
data.mood: deceptive peaceful domesticity, deep hidden romantic loyalty
data.promptProse: Standing beside a cozy dining table in a quiet safehouse, D wears a simple white apron over bare shoulders. Warm pendant light illuminates her brown hair as she turns with a soft, affectionate expression.
data.animaCaption: D standing beside a dining table in an apron, her killer facade melting into gentle warmth.
